newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African thieves steal from suicide scene.
newsitem.headline: S.African thieves steal from suicide scene.

text.p: Thieves stole the car of a dead woman after she had apparently gassed herself in the vehicle, South African police said on Wednesday.

The body was found in dense bush north of Johannesburg along with two suicide notes and a length of hosepipe which she had used to feed exhaust gases into the car, a police spokesman said in a statement.
"Police suspect that (thieves) came across the dead woman in the car, took her out...removed the piping and suicide notes and then drove off."
About 10 cars are hijacked at gunpoint each day in Johannesburg and high levels of violent crime have been blamed for keeping potential foreign investors away from South Africa.
